**# Instructions for Accurately Documenting Reportable Workplace Accidents**

These instructions cover the process from initial incident to final reporting.  "Reportable" refers to incidents that meet the criteria defined by OSHA (or your local regulatory body) and your company’s internal policies.  *Always refer to your company’s specific accident reporting procedures; these are general guidelines.*

**I. Immediate Actions & Initial Incident Records (Following Your #1)**

1.  **Start with the Incident Records:** Immediately after an accident, begin documenting. Don't delay! Memories fade quickly.
